page.layout: One printed page. Full-width running head at top: page number "72" at upper left, "EMBLEMA" centred above the title. Title line "NE SVTOR VLTRA CREPIDAM." in full width below. Centred below: an engraving (emblem woodcut) occupying the middle of the page. Below the engraving: a centred four-line verse in italic. Bottom right: a signature-like word "Pie" in the margin region.

l.i: Ordine distinxit sapiens sua munera Ihoua,
Nec cuiquam cunctis more præesse datum,
Ergo cuiq; sient primum sua munia curæ,
Ne contra plectat vindicis ira Dei.

page.notes: The engraving shows a winged-headed figure (a woman with a crown-like head, a mitre-like crozier, a sword and an open book) above a hanging hourglass with skulls, and below a woman with arms raised over her head and long loose hair, standing on a hilly landscape with trees and a castle at the right. The page number "72" and the signature "Pie" are printed at the bottom right of the text block. The first line of the verse begins "Ordine" with an initial O; the verse lines are centred and indented. The word "Ihoua" and "cuiq;" are printed as shown; "sient" is printed as shown for "sibi/sient" and may be a misprint for "sibi"; "plectat" and "vindicis" are printed as shown.
